claim_boundary.statement: This withdrawal does not assert that SBOGZB01 is not under construction, planned, paused, cancelled or completed. It records only that a bounded search found no qualifying in-window physical observation, and that the operator's own dated 2026-03-26 enumeration does not count it. Its physical state on 2026-08-20 is unknown.

withdrawn_observation_binding.note: The frozen v0.17 curated input whose 2026-07-21 lifecycle observation and evidence row this withdrawal removes from the selection; the file itself is unchanged.

shared_capture_rows.statement: SSCLHB01, SSCLLP01 and SFORPF01 stay selected and unchanged. Their status rows come from the same 2026-07-21 capture of Scala's portfolio page (the same URL, retrieval time and content hash) as the withdrawn SBOGZB01 status row, and their visible cards have also been unchanged since 2024-09-25. The versioned review did not evaluate them and recommends no change for them. Its points that the portfolio label is not a dated observation of physical work, and that a later retrieval of an unchanged label does not refresh it, bear on them as well; unlike SBOGZB01, Scala's dated 2026-03-26 report, which predates the observation window, places under-construction data centers at Huechuraba, Lampa and Fortaleza, and their in-window label can be re-anchored on the digest-verified 2026-07-02 and 2026-08-07 archive copies. Each needs its own versioned review before a final release.

withdrawal_reason: Versioned review triggered by the pre-registered blind review (position 10). The only in-window status evidence for SBOGZB01 is Scala's undated portfolio card, retrieved 2026-07-21. Archive history dates the card's content to the move from In development to Under construction between 2024-05-26 and 2024-09-25; its text is unchanged since. Scala's dated FY2025 management report (signed 2026-03-26) enumerates the group's seven data centers under construction at Tamboré, Fortaleza, Lampa and Huechuraba and does not include Bogotá. No dated authoritative observation of SBOGZB01 work inside 2026-05-22..2026-08-20 was found, and a later retrieval of an earlier label is not a fresh physical observation, so the selected observation does not meet the acceptance contract. The project, its single-project site and the two evidence rows only it used are withdrawn from the selection; the frozen v0.17 bytes are unchanged.
